note: Every element in app/index.html that a user can see or act on must be classified here.
`wired` = the module script drives it. `static` = it is not a control, and this is why.
check:app fails when an element is unclassified, when a manifest entry names something the
shell no longer has, or when a `wired` claim has no reference in app/**/*.ts.
PARADIGM (2026-09-23): `wired` only proves a reference exists. A control is honest only if
clicking it has an observable outcome — action, or a visible error. Silent `return` on a
failed precondition is a dead control (＋ NEW after 6190ad4). check:app bans that guard shape.
Empty lists must offer the recovery action in the empty state itself (see sessionsList).
Why this file exists: three rail items were written as <div>s, so the control scan never saw
them, and they stayed dead while every gate reported green. A gap can hide by simply not
being counted; this file makes not-counting a build failure.

restart.role: dock: kill and respawn the engine process

modes.static: container only; the runtime's mode chips are created inside it by the renderer

options.static: container only; selects are created from the runtime's configOptions

tools.static: container only; tool rows are created from the event stream

stream.static: container only; message and reasoning blocks are created from the stream

eventsList.static: container only; the event log rows are created by the renderer

eventsView.static: the EVENTS surface itself; reached by the viewEvents button

processView.static: the PROCESS surface itself; reached by the viewProcess button

transportPanel.static: panel shown or hidden by the register; contains no controls

sessionsRefresh.role: dossier: reload the engine's session list

sessionsList.static: container only; rows (LOAD / DEL) are created by the renderer from session/list
